items.title: OpenAI Wants to Know if an AI Industry Slowdown Would Even Be Legal
items.summary: AI leaders worry antitrust law could stand in the way of what they view as an increasingly urgent push to coordinate a slowdown in AI development.
items.author: Maxwell Zeff

items.title: Is AI Actually Going to Kill Us All?
items.summary: This week on “Uncanny Valley,” we dig into a former Anthropic researcher’s AI doomsday warning, the latest upgrades from Apple’s event, and the census report that claimed Trump won the 2020 election.
items.author: Brian Barrett, Leah Feiger, Will Knight

items.title: Everything New You Can Do With Siri AI
items.summary: When iOS 27 arrives, it will bring with it a fully revamped assistant for your iPhone.
items.author: David Nield

items.title: Clearview AI Is Testing an AI Tool That Would Let Cops Unearth Your Life Online
items.summary: InquiryIQ, a previously unreported prototype, tested a model from xAI, maker of Grok, to surface associates, social accounts, and other information about people identified through Clearview.
items.author: Dhruv Mehrotra
